an4.19:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these four ways of taking a wrong course.
an4.19:1.3: One takes a wrong course because of desire … as in 4:17 …
an4.19:1.4: These are the four ways of taking a wrong course.
an4.19:2.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these four ways of not taking a wrong course.
an4.19:2.3: One does not take a wrong course because of desire … as in 4:18 …
an4.19:2.4: These are the four ways of taking a wrong course.”
an4.19:3.1: If through desire, hate, fear, or delusion one transgresses against the Dhamma,
an4.19:3.4: like the moon in the dark fortnight.
an4.19:4.1: If one does not transgress the Dhamma through desire, hate, fear, or delusion,
an4.19:4.4: like the moon in the bright fortnight.
